ideas.pitch: Real-time satellite imagery monitoring platform to detect crop health anomalies and soil degradation specifically tailored for local farming cooperatives in the Vidarbha region.
ideas.title: VidarbhaAgriSat
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying satellite monitoring directly to local industrial or agricultural land compliance, making it immediately relevant to regional judges.

ideas.pitch: Computer-vision powered traffic flow and bottleneck analyzer utilizing existing urban CCTV feeds to dynamically optimize local signal timings.
ideas.title: NagpurTrafficPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a hyper-local civic pain point in Nagpur, giving judges an immediate, recognizable problem with a live-working dashboard demo.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and automated trust verification engine tailored for regional multi-specialty clinics.
ideas.title: MediTrust Nagpur
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adopts the winning architecture of Global-Smile, focusing on high-impact local service industries where patient trust and acquisition are major friction points.

ideas.pitch: Localized AI nutrition assistant that generates personalized meal recommendations and nutritional insights using traditional regional ingredients.
ideas.title: NutriVidarbha
ideas.why_it_could_win: Translates the winning formula of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant into a localized context, appealing to health-conscious consumers looking for culturally relevant diet tracking.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered anti-money laundering and risk detection platform combining graph intelligence and explainable machine learning for local cooperative banks.
ideas.title: FinGraph Nagpur
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy backend graph logic and explainable AI, mirroring the technical rigor that won 1st place at the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.
